text:
tasha: Quick follow-up from the authz outage postmortem. I sketched a short remediation plan and need owners + due dates so we can mark items as DONE in the tracker. Main failure modes: outdated token lib, role bindings missing owner, audit-ingest lag, and secret sync failures to staging.

tasha: Remediation list (short):
1) Upgrade token lib + add strict exp handling -> owner @ben.p -> 36h
2) Role ownership registry & policy owners PR -> owner @liam -> 5d
3) Audit ingestion gap alert + backfill job -> owner @sam.d -> 48h
4) Secrets-sync healthcheck + retry runbook -> owner @infra-owner -> 72h

ben.p: I'll take the token lib upgrade. I'll vendor v2.1.3 and add safer exp parsing. Test plan: unit tests + a canary deploy to dev cluster.

liam: I'll do the role registry work. Plan: generate CSV of role->service owners, upstream to infra, then add an automated weekly diff job. Will request review from platform leads.

sam.d: For audit ingest I'll add an alert on the ingestion lag metric (audit.ingest.lag > 30m) and a backfill job that replays raw events. ETA 48h.

infra-owner: Secrets-sync: adding a reconciliation loop that verifies secret versions across envs and retries failed deliveries. Will ensure no bulk restarts. Rolling updates only.

tasha: Nice. Please paste a 1-line confirmation with the due timestamp in epoch here once you accept. I'll create reminders and add to the remediation sheet.

ben.p: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1961012488 (36h).

liam: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1961417288 (5d).

sam.d: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1961177288 (48h).

infra-owner: :thumbsup: I accept 
Due: 1961550088 (72h).

tasha: Two cross-team asks: 1) Add the role ownership CSV to the tracker and link it. 2) Can we schedule a recurring triage that looks for "token" + "perm" regression patterns monthly? we had 4 related incidents in the last year.

liam: I'll add the CSV and wire the weekly diff. For the monthly review, I can generate a short "incident pattern" report that includes token failures, perms diffs, and secret-sync errors.

security-bot: Reminder rule created: owners will be notified at T-24h and T-4h before due. Alerts posted to #incidents-remediation. Use `/remind` to change. :robot_face:

ben.p: Quick note on the token lib change: the vulnerable case was when `exp` was parsed as float and downstream comparisons did `==`. I'll add a small snippet in the PR: 
```
exp_ts = int(float(payload["exp"]))
if now >= exp_ts: deny()
```

sam.d: For audit backfill: I'll include a dry-run mode so we can validate counts before replaying.

infra-owner: Also adding a healthcheck endpoint for the reconciler: `GET /secrets-sync/status` returns lastSyncedAt and failedDeliveries.

tasha: Perfect. I'll update the tracker and send a short note to Eng Leads about the recurring patterns once the role registry is in place. Reopen thread if any blocker.

liam: small ask 
Can security-bot post a weekly digest of incidents tagged with "authz" to help the review?

security-bot: Weekly digest enabled for tag: authz. First run scheduled in 7 days. :mailbox_with_mail:

ben.p: PR incoming in ~12h with tests and canary instructions.

sam.d: I'll post the backfill dry-run results in this thread before running the real job.

infra-owner: I'll PR the reconciler runbook by EOD.

tasha: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; tracker link posted to #sec-ops.
